dictionary: Frozen train-only PCA128 per stream from H1032;48active maximum combined per token; same native port/position access for every method.
models: 384learned log-importance scalars, one per PCA coordinate/port. ScalarTop16; block32x4 Top4groups; shared32x8 Top2groups degree2 fixed. Coordinate values remain exact PCA projections.
optimization: Adam0.03, fixed80pair steps, balanced round-robin family schedule, pair order cycles through all eligible pairs. Final step only. Log-importance clamped[-2,2];1e-4mean-square penalty.

objectives.activation: mean normalized whole-port MSE +0.1mean normalized pair-difference error
objectives.finite_causal: mean KL(native endpoint || reconstructed endpoint output) + mean KL(full donor || recipient+decoded donor-minus-recipient output), both directions. Native suffix differentiable, weights frozen.

gradient: Hard exact support forward; softmax-based straight-through gate gradients. Surrogate gradient, not derivative of discrete top-k. Fixed temperature1 and normalized score scale.
controls: Untrained selectors evaluated first; fixed initialization/memberships/schedule/objective-independent evaluation. No architecture or hyperparameter selection. Single seed pilot.
data: 120discovery endpoint occurrences,38historically opened lexical development endpoints, no original whole-task holdouts. Dictionary already fitted on discovery only. Capital diagnostic subset retained.
